summary: Full end-to-end regression for Sip 'N' Dine rebrand passed. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases green (home shape + hero eyebrow 'SIP \u2019N\u2019 DINE \u00b7 SECTOR 7', all list endpoints hygiene, sign-in, buffet-sunday claim yields 6-digit code + 60s expiry, /redemptions/verify success returns offer_title/discount/member_name, replay -> 409, unknown '000000' -> 404, /inquiries with bogus customer_id -> 401, valid customer -> 200 Received). Frontend (Playwright, mobile 375x812): Home renders warm brown theme with hero, gold promo banner, 9 tag cards, admin entry, and 'Call the house' footer; home-tag-offers routes to /offers; unauthenticated tap on offer-claim-buffet-sunday opens sign-in-modal; filling auth-name/email/phone and tapping auth-submit signs the guest in and closes the modal; second tap opens redemption-modal with a live 6-digit code; entering it on /admin via admin-key-{digit} keypad and tapping admin-verify displays admin-success card with 'QA Tester \u00b7 Signature', 'Sunday slow brunch', '20% off'. No console/pageerror observed. No _id leakage anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: Homepage hero eyebrow uses U+2019 curly apostrophes ('SIP \u2019N\u2019 DINE \u00b7 SECTOR 7' in frontend) while backend /api/home hero.eyebrow uses straight ASCII apostrophe ('SIP 'N' DINE \u00b7 SECTOR 7'). Not user-visible today because the home screen renders a hard-coded string, but if UI ever binds to hero.eyebrow the punctuation will flip. Consider standardising on one form.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST_qa_*@sipndine.com customer and one TEST inquiry via public API; no cleanup endpoint exists but records are prefixed for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://mobile-app-staging-29.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend URL exposed as EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env. Redemption codes expire in 60 seconds \u2014 keep Playwright latency < ~40s between claim and admin-verify. Admin route is /admin; keypad testIDs are admin-key-{0..9|clear|back}; success card testID is admin-success.
rca_of_issue: N/A \u2014 no bugs found in this iteration.
